title: 第17章 碧水青木丹第18章 成丹
content_zh:
以自身精血孕养血钻便是功法小成表现了，当然功法中还有一些血气相关的招式可以运用
赵国的宗门皆是中立并不隶属于正道或魔道
修炼魔功是被允许的，但若是加入正魔间的阵营则会当叛徒诛杀
湛血诀源自于一个已经失落的魔道传承，是杨威七世青年时在一处遗迹之中发现，之后也修行过一段时间，如今已是数百年后来了拿来用正好
一般人根本看不出什么，只会认为他是那种学了人家功法没有道统跟脚的散修
随着收功那枚血钻便飞入了他的掌心之中五指一握便消失不见
看着手心杨威很是满意，今后在公开场合便用此功法对敌了，不到万不得已不使用紫霞神功的招数
如今虽只有练气六重境界他却自信实力输于炼气期任何阶段
毕竟杨威曾是金丹中期修士又活了那么久，不喜与人正面争斗却也有许多生死搏杀的经历
而炼气之间的差距本就不大，只在于法力与经验的多寡
当然这只是一层保险，若是碰到筑基修士依旧难以招架
毕竟每个阶段都有对应的功法以及属性加成，炼气对筑基那便是小鸡挑战老鹰死路一条
“若是前世没被伏击就好了”
杨威不经感叹，若是他的前世身还在便可炼成人傀，金丹中期的法身炼制傀儡最少也能拥有筑基初期以上的实力
人生如棋，落子无悔，遭受了此等劫难也只有坦然接受
还有几天就是新年，开春之时便是兽潮退去进入繁衍的时期
也是水上航路最安全时期，便可去往藏宝岛拿回资源，那座岛屿没有名字地图上也没有记录，杨威第一次藏宝后便给了它这个名字
等资源齐全了他也可全力冲刺筑基，想着想着便有些困了，正是下午时分也到了该休息的时候
睡到夜幕降临杨威又坐起身来，打开窗户夜观星象双掌摊开运转观想心法感受着飘渺的星辰之力
仍无法联系一颗星辰映射，一夜无果杨威也不气垒，清晨继而打磨法力

上午时分白慧君便带着所需药材妖兽内丹来到六层靠墙的杨丹师住处
杨威将几株长相奇特有着青色纹路的药草一一摆开放在橡木茶几上
巴掌大的蓝色岩石则放在身前，这便是一阶高段妖兽水猿的妖丹
碧水青木丹所需材料多达十几种，其中最为重要的便是这水性妖丹，若是妖力不足会直接影响成丹概率和品质
水司寨家大业大不差这点，白慧君拿来的这颗妖丹质量不错，药力浑厚并未流失，显然从妖兽体内取出还不足七天
其次便是拥有着浓郁木属性的药草，皆需十年份以上的，带来的这些只有超过没有不足的
杨威一副认真检查的模样，毕竟是第一次炼制丹药，对于材料的甄别便需格外小心
“这是第一份所需的药材，第二份的已经在准备了，不多日便可取来”
白慧君见杨威表示没问题后便说道
她自然不会告诉杨威早已将两份药材准备妥当，说只准备好了一份另一份还在路上便可让对方打消猜疑
毕竟两人此前并不熟悉，两份药材的价值也是颇高，一次性给予不利于她观察
“这是先生要的夕阳花，不管成败它都归你了”
白慧君说着拿出一株如同火焰的荷花来，原本完成炼制后答应给予的奖励提前便带来了
“多谢白师姐，我一定努力炼好”
杨威并非初出茅庐的愣头青，对于这位白莲花收买人心的手段并不在意，当然也没有与其客套的意思直接便收下了
“先生只管去做就好，不必给自己太大压力”
白慧君不愧寨中第一仙子之名果然通情达理，说话的语气神态都让人很放松
content_en:
Using one's own essence and blood to conceive and nourish a blood diamond is a manifestation of the skill. Of course, there are also some blood-related moves that can be used in the skill.
The sects of Zhao State are all neutral and do not belong to the righteous path or the demonic path.
Practicing magic skills is allowed, but if you join the camp between good and evil, you will be treated as a traitor and killed.
The Zhanxue Jue originated from a lost inheritance of magic. It was discovered by Yang Wei VII in a ruins when he was young. He also practiced it for a period of time. Now hundreds of years later, it is just right for use.
Most people can't see anything at all, and they will only think that he is the kind of casual practitioner who has learned other people's exercises and has no orthodoxy.
As soon as the power was completed, the blood diamond flew into his palm and disappeared with five fingers.
Looking at the palm of his hand, Yang Wei was very satisfied. From now on, he would use this technique to fight enemies in public. He would not use Zixia Magic Technique unless absolutely necessary.
Although he is only at the sixth level of Qi training now, he is confident that his strength is inferior to any other stage in Qi training.
After all, Yang Wei was a monk in the middle stage of Jindan and lived for so long. He didn’t like to fight head-on with others, but he also had many life-and-death fight experiences.
The difference between Qi refining is not big, it just depends on the amount of mana and experience.
Of course, this is just a layer of insurance. If you encounter a foundation-building monk, it will still be difficult to resist.
After all, each stage has corresponding skills and attribute bonuses. Qi refining versus foundation building is a dead end for a chicken to challenge an eagle.
"It would have been better if I hadn't been ambushed in my previous life."
Yang Wei could not help but sigh. If his previous life was still there, he could be made into a human puppet. The puppet made from the Dharmakaya in the middle stage of Golden Elixir would at least have the strength of the early stage of foundation building.
Life is like a chess piece, you have no regrets when you make a move, and you can only accept it calmly after suffering such disasters
There are only a few days until the New Year, and the beginning of spring is the time when the beast tide recedes and enters the period of reproduction.
It is also the safest time for water routes, so you can go to the Treasure Island to retrieve resources. The island has no name and is not recorded on the map. Yang Wei gave it this name after hiding treasure for the first time.
When the resources are complete, he can sprint to build the foundation with all his strength. Thinking about it, he feels a little sleepy. It is the time to rest in the afternoon.
After sleeping until nightfall, Yang Wei sat up again, opened the window and watched the stars at night, spread out his palms and moved his mind, feeling the power of the ethereal stars.
Still unable to contact the reflection of a star, Yang Wei has no luck all night and has no air barrier. In the morning, he continues to polish his magic power.
In the morning, Bai Huijun brought the required medicinal materials, the Demonic Beast Neidan, to Master Yang's residence on the sixth floor, which was against the wall.
Yang Wei placed several strange-looking herbs with green lines on the oak coffee table one by one.
The palm-sized blue rock is placed in front of him. This is the demon elixir of the first-level high-level demon beast Water Ape.
There are more than a dozen materials required for the Blue Water Green Wood Pill, the most important of which is the water-based demon pill. If the demon power is insufficient, it will directly affect the probability and quality of the pill.
The great achievements of the Shui Sizhai family are worthy of this. The demon pill that Bai Huijun brought is of good quality, and its potency has not been lost. Apparently, it was taken out from the demon beast's body less than seven days ago.
Secondly, there are herbs with strong wood properties, all of which need to be more than ten years old. These are only more than enough.
Yang Wei looked like he was checking carefully. After all, this was his first time refining an elixir, so he needed to be extra careful in selecting the materials.
"This is the first batch of medicinal materials required. The second batch is already being prepared and will be available in a few days."
Bai Huijun saw that Yang Wei said there was no problem and said
Naturally, she would not tell Yang Wei that he had already prepared two portions of the medicinal ingredients, saying that only one portion was ready and the other was on the way to dispel his suspicions.
After all, the two of them were not familiar with each other before, and the value of the two medicinal materials was quite high. Giving them at once would not be conducive to her observation.
"This is the sunset flower that my husband asked for. Whether it succeeds or fails, it will be yours."
Bai Huijun said and took out a lotus that looked like a flame. The reward that was originally promised after completing the refining was brought in advance.
"Thank you, Senior Sister Bai. I will work hard to practice well."
Yang Wei is not a fledgling young man. For this White Lotus harvester,He didn't care about the tactics used to win people's hearts, and of course he accepted them directly without any intention of being polite.
"Sir, just do it and don't put too much pressure on yourself."
Bai Huijun lives up to the name of the number one fairy in the village. She is really reasonable and her tone of voice and demeanor make people very relaxed.
